_note: Free photographs from Unsplash (https://unsplash.com/license: free for commercial use, no permission or attribution needed). They are used only in the demo site behind the WordPress.org screenshots and are never shipped in the plugin. The files are not stored in this repository: node docs/screenshots/fetch-photos.mjs downloads them into docs/screenshots/photos/ (git-ignored). Each entry is the article it illustrates, the photo's Unsplash id (page: https://unsplash.com/photos/<id>), the image path on the Unsplash CDN, and the photographer as shown on the photo page.
